subject: VPC bridge modularization and surge test — rollout & rollback plan
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: VPC bridge modularization — draft for ACME

Hey team,

We have the go-ahead from Sales to propose the modular VPC bridge refactor to ACME next week. Before I loop them in, I want a concise proposal + an explicit rollout and rollback playbook we can attach. High-level asks:

- One-page summary (what changes, expected downtime/impact)
- Step-by-step rollout (including Helm chart change steps and TF apply ordering)
- Traffic surge simulation plan and verification checks
- Rollback steps with safe-state checkpoints and who executes them

Karthik — can you produce the draft proposal PDF? Monica — can you sketch the rollback-playbook.md (focus on network ACLs, kube-service fallbacks, and Ansible runbooks)? Rishi — please include a short verification checklist for observability (traces, netflow, token counts).

Target: have both attachments ready by EOD today so we can send to ACME ops tomorrow morning. I’ll draft the cover message once I see them.

Thanks,
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Brown <lucas.brown@acme.com>, ops-team@acme.com
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VPC bridge modularization — proposal and pilot schedule

Lucas / ACME ops,

As discussed in Wednesday’s sync, attached is a concise proposal that breaks the VPC bridge refactor into three modular deliveries: bridge-control plane split, per-region eBPF routing policy, and staged gateway replacement. Summary below:

- Objective: reduce blast radius for on-prem updates and enable per-customer gateable rollouts
- Pilot: us-east-1 edge zone (10 hosts)
- Surge test: synthetic traffic generator for 30 minutes at 1.5x expected peak; verify KV cache hit rate and 99th p90 latency target

Attachments: vpc-bridge-modularization-proposal.pdf, rollback-playbook-20261011.md

Key asks from ACME:
1) Confirmation of maintenance window on Oct 14, 02:00–04:00 UTC
2) NetOps contact for ACL changes and VIP failover test (we’ll need a permit for short IP move)
3) Any corporate change control form we need to attach (RFC or ticket)

We plan a canary on 2 hosts, then a controlled ramp to 10. If the surge test fails or net metrics exceed thresholds, we execute the rollback playbook (document attached).

Let me know if you want us to run the surge test during your low-traffic window.

—Karthik
Cloud Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Lucas Brown <lucas.brown@acme.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, ops-team@acme.com
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VPC bridge modularization — proposal and pilot schedule

Karthik,

Thanks for the summary and attachments. A few operational concerns from NetOps:

- ACL changes: we cannot change perimeter ACLs during the Oct 14 window; the earliest they can approve is Oct 18 after internal review.
- VIP failover: we require an extra 30-minute failover rehearsal on a staging VIP before any production VIP move.
- Surge test: we will not allow synthetic traffic >1.2x peak in the production environment — can you run the 1.5x test in our staging cluster first and share results?

Additionally, our security/compliance team asked whether the rollback playbook includes an HSM key rotation step if vault tokens are rotated during the operation. Please confirm.

Best,
Lucas Brown
Lead Infrastructure Engineer — ACME Corp

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Brown <lucas.brown@acme.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VPC bridge modularization — proposal and pilot schedule

On Mon, Oct 11, 2026 at 1:47 PM Lucas Brown <lucas.brown@acme.com> wrote:
> Karthik,
>
> Thanks for the summary and attachments. A few operational concerns from NetOps:
>
> - ACL changes: we cannot change perimeter ACLs during the Oct 14 window; the earliest they can approve is Oct 18 after internal review.
> - VIP failover: we require an extra 30-minute failover rehearsal on a staging VIP before any production VIP move.
> - Surge test: we will not allow synthetic traffic >1.2x peak in the production environment --- can you run the 1.5x test in our staging cluster first and share results?
>
> Additionally, our security/compliance team asked whether the rollback playbook includes an HSM key rotation step if vault tokens are rotated during the operation. Please confirm.

Hi Lucas — thanks for the quick feedback. Short answers:

- ACL timing: understood. We’ll move the production maintenance window to Oct 19 and target Oct 18 for the staging rehearsal.
- Surge test: we’ll run 1.5x in your staging cluster and provide the full telemetry export. Staging run will include loadgen, KV cache priming, and end-to-end tracing.
- HSM key rotation: the playbook currently includes a verification checkpoint to detect token rotation; we will add an explicit HSM key rotation sub-step and a guardrail that blocks automated rollbacks if key re-encryption is in flight. The new step will be highlighted in the attached rollback-playbook-20261011.md (see section 4b).

Proposed next steps:
1) Karthik and I will schedule a 30-minute staging rehearsal with your NetOps on Oct 18 (propose 09:00 UTC)
2) After a clean staging rehearsal we’ll schedule the production rollout on Oct 19, low-traffic window
3) We’ll prepare a change control ticket template for ACME to attach to your RFC process

I’ll update the attachments and resend.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Site Reliability Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Brown <lucas.brown@acme.com>, ops-team@acme.com, netops@edgebridge.io
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VPC bridge modularization — confirm rehearsal and docs attached

Lucas / ACME NetOps / EdgeBridge,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the constraints — we’ll adjust to your schedule. Confirming:

- Staging rehearsal: Oct 18, 09:00 UTC (30 min) — Karthik to run the surge test at 1.5x in staging and deliver telemetry export
- Production rollout: Oct 19, 02:00–04:00 UTC (moved from Oct 14)
- Documents attached: vpc-bridge-modularization-proposal.pdf (short design + timeline) and rollback-playbook-20261011.md (explicit HSM guardrail and ACL safe-state)

Please reply with the NetOps contact who will take the ACL change ticket and who will own the VIP rehearsal. If we don’t hear back by EOD (ACME local), we’ll provisionally book the staging rehearsal and include an option to reschedule.

Thanks everyone — see you on the rehearsal.

—Stephanie
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
